notes.title: Discover the Whimsy of Puzzles in Tukoni: Forest Keepers!
notes.content:
Our dear Forest Keepers,

We’re thrilled to share a little peek into the magical puzzles and mini-games waiting for you in Tukoni: Forest Keepers! Whether you’re brewing fragrant teas, organizing cozy spaces, or cracking whimsical padlocks, every challenge is steeped in the charm of our kind hand-drawn world. Here’s a taste of what’s in store:

[h2]The Ritual of Leaves
[/h2]
In the heart of Yavir, the bustling hub where Tukoni gather, you’ll meet Tea Tukoni — the revered master of tea ceremonies. Tea Tukoni will guide you through the ancient art of brewing, teaching you how to combine fragrant herbs found throughout the forest. Each blend brings warmth and comfort to those who sip it. Keep your eyes open for rare herbs and new recipes; every cup is a delightful discovery.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/53a1a22aa07e83e9206c1a363691d8778ae8f699.png[/img]

[h2]The Art of Tidying
[/h2]
Organizing is an art! Our cozy grid puzzles invite you to fit a variety of items into snug, diegetic spaces. Each object has a unique shape, making it a delightful challenge to get everything to fit just right. In Tukoni: Forest Keepers, organizing spaces becomes part of the adventure.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/ecce1bcbeaf59d483028072324954c0ff74e2a05.png[/img]

[h2]The Lore of Locks
[/h2]
The forest spirits and critters may be adorable, but they are also notoriously forgetful! That’s where you come in. Scattered across the world are chests, shelves, and other locked treasures, waiting to be opened. Solve gentle puzzles, follow clever hints, and use your keen observation skills to discover what’s hidden within. Each padlock has a story to tell, so get ready to turn those keys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/2cf657e780eddc2b97b5932194c557c06063f750.jpg[/img]

We can’t wait for you to experience these delightful puzzles and mini-games for yourself. Stay cozy and keep an eye out for more sneak peeks as we get closer to the demo release, and then the launch!

Before we sign off for today, here are two more screenshots from our upcoming game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/22bd1e2f1130843f898dba51935ff2427eb01f1f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45051864/f287fd0e9374dee4347b48cd567b2fe2a7195d8a.png[/img]
May your teapots stay warm and your puzzles stay delightful! See you soon!

Kind regards, Tukoni dev team.
